attributes.semantic_bug_evidence: TARGET-BYTE PROOF OF A WRONG GAMEPLAY CONSTANT. Target 0x40: `lfs f26,0(0) @lbl_80345B30`; build/GUNE5D/asm/auto_11_803459F0_sdata2.s line for .sdata2:0x140 | 0x80345B30 declares `.float 32`. Target 0x148-0x150: `lfs f1,0(0) @gClockFrameStep` then `fnmsubs f0,f26,f1,f0` = fb - fa*fc = *pvy - 32.0f*gClockFrameStep. Our source read `*pvy = -(f32)(8.0 * gClockFrameStep - *pvy)` = *pvy - 8.0*gClockFrameStep. Spewed boss items (coins/loot) therefore fell at ONE QUARTER the retail gravity. CRITICAL METRIC FINDING: fixing the value ALONE probed NEUTRAL (real 187, insns T127/O140, multiset 35t all unchanged) because the constant lives in a data pool and never changes the instruction stream - this bug class is INVISIBLE to fuzzy, real and the opcode multiset alike, which is why it survived under a 'register-renumber / FP-form residual' park label. Every other constant in the function was audited the same way and is CORRECT: 0x80345AC0 .double 0.5, 0x80345AD0 .float 0, 0x80345B00 .float 10, 0x80345B08 .double 1, 0x80345B10 .float 1, 0x80345B18 .double 0.1, 0x80345B20 .double 0.4, 0x80345B28 .double 4. Struct offsets also audited clean against target: worldPos 0x34 (lfs 52/56/60), active 0xc4 signed (lha r0,196 + rlwinm bit 23 = mask 0x100), objgrp +4.
